'''Raine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] soldier living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. He was a member of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and was part of the [[Eternal Alliance Recon Unit|Alliance Recon Unit]], created and deployed in response to various uprisings sparkling across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]], Empress [[Vaylin]] and reorganization of the Alliance into the Eternal Alliance. Along with the rest of the unit Raine participated in such crises as reclaiming the stolen plans for the [[Alliance base]] from the [[Dust Vipers]] pirates, liberating [[Port Nowhere]] from the [[Crimson Fang]] takeover and neutralizing Sith Lords [[Adacin]] and [[Zanisk]] in the former [[Separatist stronghold]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Eventually, during the [[Assault on Denova|attack]] on [[Denova]] by General [[Amos Rike]] and his [[Rike's Raiders|forces]], the unit's shuttle was shot down and crashed, nearly killing Raine and injuring the other members.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raine appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during various Uprisings.
